articles.title: VÍDEO mostra passageiro ensanguentado e homens caídos em avião que desviou de Tel Aviv por suposto atentado  | G1
articles.standfirst: Voo FZ1073 da FlyDubai, que saiu de Dubai rumo a Tel Aviv, despencou mais de 4 mil metros após emitir sinais de emergência por uma suposta briga de pilotos com facadas. Governo israelense fala de tentativa de atentado. Em vídeo, passageiro com sangue pede ajuda e mostra homens com ferimentos.
articles.summary: Voo FZ1073 da FlyDubai, que saiu de Dubai rumo a Tel Aviv, despencou mais de 4 mil metros após emitir sinais de emergência por uma suposta briga de pilotos com facadas. Governo israelense fala de tentativa de atentado. Em vídeo, passageiro com sangue pede ajuda e mostra homens com ferimentos.
articles.body:
Imagens registradas dentro do avião da FlyDubai com destino a Tel Aviv , que foi desviado nesta quarta-feira (30) após um suposto atentado terrorista , mostraram um passageiro ensanguentado e homens no chão com ferimentos.

➡️ O governo israelense disse que o copiloto do voo tentou esfaquear o piloto e derrubar o avião. Eles entraram em confronto, o que fez a aeronave despencar quase 5 mil metros em 30 segundos. A tripulação conseguiu tomar o controle do voo, que pousou com segurança na Arábia Saudita .

No vídeo, um passageiro com marcas de sangue pede ajuda e fala que houve um ataque com facas no avião ( veja nas imagens acima ) . Na sequência, dois homens — supostamente o piloto e o copiloto — aparecem no chão e com ferimentos.

A agência de notícias Reuters verificou as imagens.

Passageiros ensanguentados após briga entre pilotos em voo da FlyDubai rumo a Israel que foi desviado para a Arábia Saudita em 30 de setembro de 2026. — Foto: Reprodução/redes sociais

O primeiro-ministro de Israel , Benjamin Netanyahu, afirmou que o caso foi uma tentativa de atentado por parte do copiloto, um cidadão de Omã. Ele foi preso e, em interrogatório, afirmou que agiu sozinho.

O ministro de Segurança Nacional de Israel, Itamar Ben Gvir, disse ainda que o copiloto tinha como objetivo matar israelenses, que eram maioria entre os 180 passageiros a bordo. Apesar do susto, nenhum deles sofreu ferimentos por conta do ataque.

A FlyDubai afirmou que apenas alguns passageiros ficaram levemente feridos em decorrência da queda brusca e receberam atendimento.

O voo FZ1073 da FlyDubai havia saído de Dubai , nos Emirados Árabes Unidos, no início desta manhã, com destino a Tel Aviv, em Israel. Quando já estava próximo do espaço aéreo israelense, o copiloto atacou o piloto, que reagiu, segundo o governo israelense.

O confronto entre os dois deixou a aeronave temporariamente sem controle e fez o avião despencar cerca de 4.300 metros em cerca de 30 segundos, segundo o site de monitoramento aéreo Flightradar24

Passageiros perceberam o confronto e, junto de tripulantes, conseguiram conter o copiloto, segundo relataram pessoas que estavam no voo. Em um vídeo que gravou para parentes, um dos passageiros, o israelense Itzhak Liber, afirmou que "um homem descontrolado com uma faca esfaqueou um dos pilotos".

"Estamos aqui no avião vindo de Dubai. Estamos aqui no avião; havia um homem descontrolado com uma faca que esfaqueou um dos pilotos. Nós agimos e ajudamos o piloto", disse Liber. Outra passageira relatou "sangue por todo o lado".

Sinais de emergência e pouso na Arábia Saudita

Os radares registraram o descontrole do voo. Quando o avião sobrevoava a Jordânia, vizinha de Israel, sinais de emergência começaram a ser emitidos pela aeronave. Um deles transmitiu o código de sequestro da aviação mundial, e a rota foi bruscamente alterada para a Arábia Saudita.

Apesar de ambos os pilotos estarem feridos, o avião pousou em segurança na cidade de Tabuk, na Arábia Saudita.

A FlyDubai afirmou, em comunicado, que "a tripulação" fez a aterrissagem, mas não esclareceu quais membros da equipe fizeram o pouso. Passageiros, no entanto, relataram que pilotos que eram passageiros no voo comandaram o pouso.

Israel chegou a solicitar que caças sauditas escoltassem o voo durante a operação para o pouso, mas o pedido foi negado, segundo o próprio governo da Arábia Saudita.

O ministro da Segurança Nacional israelense, Itamar Ben Gvir, afirmou que o terrorista tinha como objetivo assassinar os israelenses a bordo — 100 dos 180 passageiros eram cidadãos de Israel, segundo o governo israelense.

O aeroporto saudita de Tabuk, onde o voo aterrissou, afirmou que tanto o piloto quanto o copiloto ficaram feridos e foram hospitalizados, e que passageiros também receberam atendimento.

Segundo Netanyahu, a Arábia Saudita deteve e interrogou o copiloto e abriu uma investigação sobre o caso. A mídia israelense afirmou que o Mossad, a principal agência de inteligência do país e responsável por operações especiais e secretas, também está investigando o caso.

Horas depois, um segundo voo da FlyDubai rumo a Tel Aviv fez um breve desvio em sua rota, segundo o FlightRadar24, porém retomou o caminho. O motivo do desvio não havia sido divulgado até a última atualização desta reportagem.

A FlyDubai opera voos diários entre Dubai e Tel Aviv, uma rota muito utilizada por cidadãos israelenses.

articles.title: Morre Nelson Mathídios, ex-prefeito de Guaratinguetá, aos 84 anos | G1
articles.standfirst: Mathídios comandou a cidade entre 1993 e 1996; prefeitura decretou luto oficial de três dias.
articles.summary: Prefeitura de Guaratinguetá decretou luto de 3 dias.
articles.body:
Nelson Antônio Mathídios dos Santos, ex-prefeito de Guaratinguetá — Foto: Reprodução/PMG

O ex-prefeito de Guaratinguetá, Nelson Mathídios, morreu na manhã desta quarta-feira (30). A informação foi confirmada pela Prefeitura de Guaratinguetá.

A causa da morte não foi informada. Mathídios foi prefeito de Guaratinguetá entre 1993 e 1996. Antes de entrar para a política, teve atuação no comércio e na representação empresarial.

Ele presidiu o Sindicato do Comércio Varejista de Guaratinguetá e participou da articulação para a instalação de uma unidade do Senac no município.

O velório é realizado no Velório Municipal, ao lado do IML de Guaratinguetá. O sepultamento está marcado para as 16h desta quarta-feira (30), no Cemitério do Pedregulho.

Em nota, a Prefeitura de Guaratinguetá informou que decretou luto oficial de três dias no município.

articles.title: Incêndio atinge galpão de empresa de aluguel de brinquedos na Bahia | G1
articles.standfirst: Caso aconteceu na cidade de Barreiras, no oeste do estado. Cerca de 42 equipamentos e um caminhão foram destruídos pelas chamas.
articles.summary: Caso aconteceu na cidade de Barreiras, no oeste do estado. Cerca de 42 equipamentos e um caminhão foram destruídos pelas chamas.
articles.body:
Um incêndio destruiu um galpão de uma empresa que trabalha com aluguel de brinquedos e equipamentos para festas e eventos em Barreiras , no oeste da Bahia. As chamas atingiram o imóvel na madrugada de terça-feira (29), na Rua São Jorge, no bairro Morada da Lua de Cima.

Segundo o proprietário da empresa, o prejuízo estimado é de aproximadamente R$ 800 mil. Cerca de 42 equipamentos foram destruídos, entre eles brinquedos infláveis, fantasias e um robô de LED.

Um caminhão usado para transportar os brinquedos também foi atingido pelo fogo e ficou destruído. Ainda de acordo com o proprietário, a empresa havia perdido recentemente outro caminhão em um incêndio.

O Corpo de Bombeiros Militar da Bahia foi acionado às 2h42 para combater as chamas. As equipes controlaram o incêndio, isolaram a área e retiraram o caminhão atingido com o auxílio de um guincho.

Após a extinção das chamas, os bombeiros retornaram ao local para fazer o rescaldo e resfriar materiais que ainda apresentavam pequenos focos e produziam fumaça. O último rescaldo foi concluído às 20h20.

A estrutura do galpão apresentou trincas e fissuras e, por isso, a edificação permaneceu isolada. A Defesa Civil de Barreiras foi acionada para avaliar o imóvel.

Até o momento, não há informações sobre o que provocou o incêndio. A causa deverá ser apurada pelas autoridades competentes.

articles.title: Carteira da Mãe Atípica: Detran inicia emissão em novembro; veja como | G1
articles.standfirst: Documento fica disponível em versão física e digital, gerada em até 5 dias úteis após entrega da física. Medida promete facilitar processos burocráticos para quem é cuidador principal.
articles.summary: Documento fica disponível em versão física e digital, gerada em até 5 dias úteis após entrega da física. Medida facilita processos burocráticos para quem é cuidador principal.
articles.body:
Karine Sartor e seu filho Luiz Felipe: a partir de agora, ela e todas as mães atípicas têm direito a uma carteira de identidade exclusiva — Foto: Divulgação

O Detran -RJ publicou em Diário Oficial a portaria que regulamenta o documento de identificação da mãe atípica, chamado de Carteira da Mãe Atípica . A norma, publicada nesta quarta-feira (30), entra em vigor a partir do dia 3 de novembro deste ano.

O documento garante prioridade no atendimento nas áreas de saúde, educação e assistência social, além de facilitar o acesso a serviços públicos e a benefícios específicos .

Como reconhecimento da condição de cuidador principal, a carteira também serve como comprovante de condição especial em processos administrativos .

Apesar do nome mencionar mães atípicas, podem solicitar a carteira a mãe , o pai ou o responsável legal de pessoa com deficiência, transtorno do neurodesenvolvimento ou doença rara de quem seja o cuidador principal .

Cada requerente recebe um único documento, mesmo que cuide de mais de uma pessoa. A carteira só será válida quando acompanhada do documento de identidade.

Segundo a portaria, é preciso ter carteira de iIdentidade emitida pelo Detran RJ há menos de 10 anos, com CPF cadastrado, e declarar ser o cuidador principal. O filho ou a pessoa sob responsabilidade também precisa ter carteira de identidade e cartão PCD.

O pedido é feito por formulário eletrônico nos canais digitais do Detran e deve ser feito no semestre de aniversário do filho ou da pessoa sob responsabilidade (de janeiro a junho ou de julho a dezembro).

A primeira via é gratuita e o documento vale por cinco anos. A renovação pode ser pedida a partir de 30 dias antes do vencimento, com a comprovação de que os requisitos continuam sendo cumpridos.

O documento traz a foto do titular, os dados da pessoa assistida, o tipo de deficiência informado no Cartão PCD e um QR Code para validação da autenticidade.

Os dados passam por validação eletrônica automática e, se alguma informação não for confirmada, o requerente deve solicitar a regularização do cadastro (por exemplo, emitir a identidade ou o Cartão PCD) para cumprir as condições previstas.

A carteira foi criada pela Lei Estadual nº 11.186/2026, de autoria do deputado estadual Fred Pacheco (PL-RJ). O projeto foi aprovado na Assembleia Legislativa (Alerj), sancionado pelo governo do estado e publicado em maio deste ano. A Portaria Detran nº 7213 é a regulamentação que passa a colocar a lei em prática.

articles.title: Morte de tilápias em Ourinhos: prejuízo de R$ 500 mil após apagão | G1
articles.standfirst: Apagão entre a noite de segunda (28) e a manhã de terça-feira (29) paralisou os aeradores que oxigenam os tanques da propriedade. Peixes estavam em fase de engorda há um ano e meio.
articles.summary: Morte de tilápias em Ourinhos ocorreu após 16 horas sem energia paralisarem aeradores dos tanques, gerando prejuízo de R$ 500 mil para o criador local.
articles.body:
Um morador de Ourinhos (SP) relatou que uma interrupção no fornecimento de energia elétrica registrada entre a noite de segunda-feira (28) e a manhã de terça-feira (29) teria provocado a morte de aproximadamente 6 toneladas de tilápias em uma criação particular no condomínio de chácaras Santa Maria.

Em contato com a TV TEM , o responsável pela criação estima que o prejuízo ultrapasse R$ 500 mil.

De acordo com ele, a energia acabou por volta das 19h de segunda-feira e foi restabelecida aproximadamente às 11h do dia seguinte, deixando os moradores cerca de 16 horas sem eletricidade.

No local, ele mantém três tanques com criação particular de tilápias, que estavam há cerca de um ano e meio de criação e engorda.

Produtor diz ter perdido seis toneladas de peixe em Ourinhos após queda de energia que durou 16 horas — Foto: Dionatan Bueno/ Arquivo pessoal

Os tanques utilizam aeradores elétricos para manter a oxigenação da água e, com a interrupção prolongada, os equipamentos deixaram de funcionar.

A TV TEM entrou em contato com a Companhia Paulista de Força e Luz (CPFL) Santa Cruz, que afirmou que a falta de energia ocorreu devido à queda de uma árvore de grande porte sobre a rede de distribuição.

Segundo o órgão, as equipes atuaram e a energia foi restabelecida. Além disso, a CPFL entrará em contato com o cliente para esclarecimentos sobre o caso.

articles.title: Matemática Vanguarda em outubro desafia estudantes a resolver 20 contas em apenas 30 segundos; veja como funciona | G1
articles.standfirst: Projeto reúne 22 alunos da rede municipal de São Sebastião em seletivas nos dias 6 e 8 de outubro; final será realizada no dia 20.
articles.summary: Projeto reúne 22 alunos da rede municipal de São Sebastião em seletivas nos dias 6 e 8 de outubro; final será realizada no dia 20.
articles.body:
Matemática Vanguarda desafia os alunos a resolver 20 contas em apenas 30 segundos. — Foto: Rede Vanguarda

Você conseguiria resolver 20 contas de matemática em apenas 30 segundos? Esse é o desafio que estudantes da rede municipal de São Sebastião vão encarar durante o Matemática Vanguarda , projeto da Rede Vanguarda que chega à cidade em outubro.

Ao todo, 22 estudantes dos anos finais do ensino fundamental participam da competição, que testa conhecimento matemático, raciocínio e concentração.

Cada participante terá que resolver 10 contas de multiplicação e 10 de divisão dentro do tempo determinado. A disputa acontece em etapas e vai selecionar os alunos que avançam para a grande final.

Os estudantes foram divididos em quatro grupos. Dois deles são formados por alunos de escolas do Centro e da Costa Norte, enquanto os outros dois reúnem estudantes da Costa Sul.

As primeiras seletivas acontecem no dia 6 de outubro, às 10h, no Auditório Cynthia Cliquet. A disputa será entre os estudantes dos grupos 1 e 2, formados por alunos do Centro e da Costa Norte.

Já no dia 8 de outubro, às 10h, será a vez dos grupos 3 e 4, formados por estudantes da Costa Sul. A seletiva será realizada no Ginásio Poliesportivo da EM Guiomar, em Boiçucanga.

Ao final das duas etapas, um estudante de cada grupo será escolhido para disputar a final, que terá quatro participantes.

A grande decisão está marcada para o dia 20 de outubro, às 14h, no Teatro Municipal de São Sebastião.

A proposta do Matemática Vanguarda é aproximar escolas, estudantes e comunidade em torno da educação e transformar a matemática em uma experiência que vá além da sala de aula.

O projeto é apresentado por Kelly Maria, com oferecimento da Prefeitura de São Sebastião e apoio do Instituto Alpha Lumen.

articles.title: Joelma e Rey Vaqueiro gravam clipe de 'Príncipe Encantado' em Belém | G1
articles.standfirst: Gravação aberta ao público no Boulevard da Gastronomia é de nova versão, que une o calypso da cantora paraense ao forró de vaquejada.
articles.summary: Gravação aberta ao público na Praça do Boulevard da Gastronomia será de nova versão, que une o calypso da cantora paraense ao forró de vaquejada.
articles.body:
Joelma e Rey Vaqueiro gravam clipe em Belém. — Foto: Divulgação

Belém será o cenário de um encontro musical que promete agitar os fãs do ritmo paraense e do forró. Nesta quarta-feira (30), Joelma e Rey Vaqueiro se reúnem para a gravação do videoclipe de "Príncipe Encantado".

O registro audiovisual começou a ser feito na Praça do Boulevard da Gastronomia, a partir das 16h, com acesso gratuito para o público.

A faixa escolhida para a parceria é um marco na trajetória de Joelma, lançada originalmente na época da Banda Calypso. A canção ganha uma roupagem moderna no repertório de Rey Vaqueiro, promovendo uma fusão entre o calypso, o forró e a música de vaquejada.

Para Joelma, gravar o projeto em sua terra natal traz um sentimento de nostalgia e renovação.

"‘Príncipe Encantado’ é uma música que eu canto há muitos anos e que continua muito presente nos meus shows e na minha história. Agora, poder gravar uma nova versão ao lado do Rey, e ainda fazer isso em Belém, tem um significado muito especial para mim", destaca a cantora.

Rey Vaqueiro chega ao projeto após uma maratona intensa de apresentações. Entre junho e agosto deste ano, o cantor realizou 119 shows pelo Brasil, sendo 57 apresentações apenas em junho, o que o colocou no topo do ranking de artistas com mais shows no período de São João. Em julho, foram 36 apresentações, seguidas por 26 em agosto.

O cantor, que vem conquistando o país com sucessos como "Body Splash", "Nome Proibido" e "Estrela", celebrou a parceria com a estrela paraense.

"‘Príncipe Encantado’ já está presente nos meus shows e gravar esse clipe ao lado da Joelma torna esse projeto ainda mais especial", afirma Rey Vaqueiro.

articles.standfirst: Atividade do Projeto Golfinho Rotador teve experiências sensoriais e visitas a espaços de educação ambiental.
articles.summary: Atividade do Projeto Golfinho Rotador teve experiências sensoriais e visitas a espaços de educação ambiental.
articles.body:
O Projeto Golfinho Rotador realizou, nesta quarta-feira (30), uma oficina de educação ambiental para crianças neurodivergentes de Fernando de Noronha ( veja vídeo acima ). A atividade “Inclusão em Campo – Conhecendo e Protegendo o Mar” reuniu 12 crianças e foi promovida em parceria com o Núcleo de Apoio Psicossocial e Pedagógico (NAPP).

O termo neurodivergente é usado para descrever pessoas que apresentam formas diferentes de funcionamento do cérebro e de processamento de informações. A ação aconteceu no Centro de Visitantes do Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade ( ICMBio )

Oficina foi promovida pelo Projeto Golfinho Rotador — Foto: Ana Clara Marinho/TV Globo

Segundo os organizadores, a programação foi criada para aproximar as crianças da natureza de forma inclusiva, com atividades de educação ambiental, estímulos sensoriais e brincadeiras.

As crianças conheceram a exposição sobre o Parque Nacional Marinho e também visitaram o Centro de Visitantes do Projeto Tamar .

“Esses espaços são didáticos e ricos em informação. As crianças neurodivergentes são mais sensíveis ao ambiente e podem ser mais impactadas por sons, cheiros e poluição visual, por exemplo. Isso mostra que elas também podem perceber o ambiente de uma forma muito particular”, avaliou o coordenador do Projeto Golfinho Rotador, José Martins.

José Martins também destacou que o contato com a natureza pode ajudar a tranquilizar as crianças.

“As pesquisas indicam que a aproximação com a natureza é positiva porque tranquiliza. Se isso fizer parte da vida dessas crianças, elas vão ter essa ferramenta de tranquilidade”, afirmou Martins.

A gestora do NAPP em Fernando de Noronha, Massilde Martins Costa, informou que a ilha tem cerca de 70 crianças neurodivergentes. Ela avaliou que essa atividade contribui para o desenvolvimento das crianças.

“A atividade faz as crianças sentirem que são importantes, amadas e acolhidas. Essa ação também dá visibilidade e mostra que as pessoas neurodivergentes são capazes”, afirmou Massilde Costa.

Enzo, de 8 anos, participou da atividade e gostou de saber mais sobre os animais marinhos.

“Eles falaram sobre tartaruga, tubarão e golfinhos. Eu já vi esses bichos no mar e também gosto da raia, que tem um ferrão. Eu achei esse passeio muito bom”, contou Enzo.

Essa foi a primeira atividade do Projeto Golfinho Rotador voltada especificamente para crianças neurodivergentes. A iniciativa amplia as ações de educação ambiental e busca aproximar diferentes públicos da conservação da vida marinha em Fernando de Noronha.

Criado em 1990, o projeto realiza pesquisas e ações de conservação dos golfinhos em Fernando de Noronha, com apoio do Programa Petrobras Socioambiental. A ONG também promove oficinas culturais, incentiva o surfe entre jovens e desenvolve atividades educativas nas duas escolas da ilha.

articles.title: Aborto na Polônia: Ativistas inauguram armário de pílulas | G1
articles.standfirst: O “abortomat” tem 22 compartimentos com medicamentos e funciona em frente ao Parlamento, em meio às rígidas restrições do país à interrupção da gravidez.
articles.summary: Aborto na Polônia: O "abortomat" oferece acesso anônimo a medicamentos em frente ao Parlamento, desafiando as rígidas leis de interrupção da gravidez no país.
articles.body:
Ativistas inauguram na Polônia primeiro armário para retirada de pílulas abortivas — Foto: WOJTEK RADWANSKI / AFP

Ativistas polonesas inauguraram o primeiro armário para distribuir pílulas abortivas no país, permitindo que mulheres acessem o medicamento de forma rápida e anônima, apesar da legislação rigorosa, observou um fotógrafo da AFP.

Na Polônia, o aborto é legal apenas em dois casos: quando a gravidez é resultado de um crime, como estupro ou incesto, ou quando há risco para a vida ou saúde da mãe. No entanto, nenhuma lei penaliza mulheres que realizam abortos por conta própria, por exemplo, com pílulas compradas online.

O pequeno armário rosa, apelidado de "abortomat" pelas ativistas, possui 22 compartimentos contendo envelopes com medicamentos para abortos farmacológicos.

"Buscamos constantemente soluções para tornar o acesso ao aborto mais simples, mais acessível, menos impessoal e mais centrado nas pessoas", disse à AFP Kinga Jelinska, diretora da fundação Women Help Women, uma organização canadense, e cofundadora da Abortion Dream Team.

O "abortomat" está localizado em um centro de apoio ao aborto criado por ativistas há mais de um ano, em um local simbólico: em frente ao Parlamento polonês, que não cumpriu suas promessas de flexibilizar as leis sobre o aborto.

Em vez de ser uma clínica médica convencional, o centro oferece às mulheres acesso a recursos, principalmente pílulas abortivas, além de um espaço onde podem buscar apoio ou realizar um aborto farmacológico.

As brechas na lei permitem que o centro continue funcionando, afirmam as ativistas.

"O abortomat é, de certa forma, um 'subterfúgio' contra a lei", afirma Kinga Jelinska.

Como a Polônia pune o auxílio ao aborto com até três anos de prisão, "as pílulas são dispensadas por uma máquina operada por uma organização sediada fora da Polônia", explicam.

A criação do centro de aborto provocou protestos de grupos católicos conservadores.

articles.title: Gal Leite propõe municipalizar a merenda escolar no Pará | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidata da Unidade Popular ao Governo do Estado cumpriu agenda de campanha com feirantes e comerciantes em Castanhal, nesta terça-feira, 29.
articles.summary: Candidata da Unidade Popular ao Governo do Estado cumpriu agenda de campanha com feirantes e comerciantes em Castanhal, nesta terça-feira, 29.
articles.body:
A candidata da Unidade Popular ao Governo do Pará, Gal Leite , disse nesta terça-feira (29) que quer realizar a municipalização da merenda escolar, fornecida pela agricultura familiar, caso seja eleita governadora do Estado.

"Os alimentos que chegam na mesa das pessoas são produzidos pela agricultura familiar. Então, queremos criar linhas de crédito para a agricultura familiar e também fazer com que as pessoas do interior não precisem sair para outras cidades para conseguir emprego. Como? Criando as frentes emergenciais de trabalho", afirmou.

Gal Leite participou de uma ação de campanha para conversar com trabalhadores em Castanhal . A mobilização foi no Complexo de Feiras da Ceasa, na área central do município, e reuniu apoiadores para a distribuição de panfletos.

Durante a agenda, ela conversou com as pessoas que passavam pelo local, abordou feirantes e outros comerciantes da área.

Os trabalhadores e frequentadores que participaram da mobilização falaram sobre as necessidades locais. Durante o encontro, eles puderam dialogar com a candidata sobre melhorias para a região.

Todas as demandas foram ouvidas por Gal Leite. Ao final da agenda, ela apresentou as propostas de governo pensadas para atender as necessidades na área da saúde pública.

A candidata anunciou que uma das mudanças será a "substituição progressiva de empresas terceirizadas, trocando os temporários por servidores concursados".

Gal Leite também afirmou que planeja reestruturar o quadro de profissionais de saúde no estado.

Ela também prometeu a "realização de concursos periódicos para médicos, enfermeiros, técnicos, psicólogos, assistentes sociais e outras categorias que atuam na área da saúde".

articles.title: Court halts execution of Christa Gail Pike for a Tennessee murder she committed at age 18
articles.summary: Tennessee's execution of Christa Gail Pike for a murder she committed at age 18 was halted Wednesday about an hour before it was set to begin, as a federal a...
articles.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn. (AP) — Tennessee's execution of Christa Gail Pike for a murder she committed at age 18 was halted Wednesday about an hour before it was set to begin, as a federal appeals court sought to review whether her allegations of childhood sexual abuse and rape were fully considered at her sentencing.

Pike, now 50, and her boyfriend were convicted of the 1995 stabbing and beating of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer, their classmate at a job training facility in Knoxville. She would have been the first woman executed in Tennessee in at least 200 years.

The 6th Circuit U.S. Court of Appeals halted the execution on a 2-1 vote after execution witnesses and others gathered at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville.

The case garnered widespread attention at the time of the killing in part because a pentagram that was carved on Slemmer's body and other elements of the crime stoked fears of Satan worship during the "satanic panic" of the 1980s and 1990s.

Decision stopping execution is immediately appealed

After the stay was granted, Tennessee's attorney general immediately appealed to the U.S. Supreme Court. Witnesses and media remained at the prison in case the high court allows the execution to proceed.

Halting the execution at the last moment traumatized Slemmer's family and rewarded "abusive delay tactics" by Pike's attorneys, the attorney general's office wrote in its appeal to the Supreme Court.

Pike's lawyers said not considering what happened to her growing up violates any view of fairness with executions.

"It is inconceivable that in the 21st century, the criminal justice system is poised to execute a survivor of rape and child sexual abuse whose jury never had the opportunity to consider those facts in weighing the defendant's moral culpability," they wrote.

Pike's case renewed debate on the death penalty for teens

As the execution date drew near, it renewed debate over the death penalty for young offenders.

Pike does not deny committing the killing, but her supporters argue the state should consider Pike's age at the time, mental illness and a history of severe sexual abuse that included being raped from the time she was a toddler. Assistant Federal Defender Stephen Ferrell said Pike's death sentence is an outlier because other 18-year-olds in Tennessee have had such sentences vacated.

After the killing, Pike was diagnosed with bipolar disorder and post-traumatic stress disorder. In her clemency petition, she said she only wanted to fight Slemmer but killed her in a frenzied attack when she couldn't "put the brakes on."

"I was a mentally ill 18-year-old kid. It took me numerous years to even realize the gravity of what I'd done. Even more to accept how many lives I affected. I took the life of someone's child, sister, friend. It sickens me now to think I had the ability to commit such a crime," Pike said in a statement.

Victim's mother says she is waiting for death sentence

Slemmer's mother wants the lethal injection to go forward, saying she has waited decades to see Pike's sentence carried out.

"Every time I think about it, I think about Colleen feeling that pain and trying to get up and run," May Martinez told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Saturday.

Martinez said a group helped raise money so she and her husband could travel from Florida to witness the execution. She didn't respond to a message Wednesday after the execution was halted.

Martinez said her daughter's age also should matter in deciding Pike's fate.

"Not a day goes by, or a minute goes by that I do not think about Colleen. Holidays are the worst," she said, noting that her daughter would have turned 51 earlier in September.

The killing rocked the city of Knoxville. Prosecutors said Pike, fearing Slemmer was trying to steal her boyfriend, lured her to a wooded area on Jan. 12, 1995. Pike cut Slemmer with a box cutter and beat her with a large chunk of asphalt. Shipp, Pike's boyfriend, has admitted that he was the one who carved a pentagram, a star-shaped symbol associated with Satan, into her body.

Shipp was 17 when the crime happened and received a sentence of life in prison with the possibility of parole. Pike was the only one sentenced to death.

Tennessee has not executed a woman for at least 200 years, according to Robin M. Maher, executive director of the Death Penalty Information Center. Older records can be spotty, though, so it's difficult to know precise details about the last woman who was put to death there.

Since the Supreme Court reinstated the death penalty in 1976, 18 women have been put to death in the U.S., representing about 1% of all executions, according to the center.

Most recently, Missouri in 2023 executed Amber McLaughlin for a 2003 killing, in what is believed to be the first execution of a transgender woman in the U.S. In 2021, the federal government executed Lisa Montgomery, marking the first time in nearly seven decades that the U.S. government put a female inmate to death.

Pike would be the 30th person executed in the U.S. this year after Florida carried out an execution on Tuesday.

Associated Press journalists Jeffrey Collins in Columbia, South Carolina, and Ed White in Detroit contributed to this report.
authors: KIM CHANDLER and KRISTIN M. HALL

articles.title: Flydubai scare: Netanyahu orders tighter security on Israeli, foreign carriers
articles.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday ordered authorities to “ramp up” security on both Israeli and foreign carriers operating to and
articles.body: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday ordered authorities to “ramp up” security on both Israeli and foreign carriers operating to and from the country following the flydubai cockpit incident, the Prime Minister’s Office said.The move came after Flight FZ1073, travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv, was diverted to Saudi Arabia following a violent confrontation between the pilots.Netanyahu described the episode as a “highly severe security incident”. In a video address, he said, “During the flight as they approached the country one of the pilots stabbed the other pilot. Apparently he tried to crash the plane with its occupants.” Netanyahu said “almost all” passengers were Israelis and that some passengers, along with crew members, broke into the cockpit after the aircraft began to dive. “I spoke with one of the Israeli passengers. He told me that the plane went into a spin and began to dive. He told me that somehow he managed to break into the cockpit with one of the crew members and together they neutralized the stabbing pilot while he was trying to sabotage the aircraft’s systems,” he said.The pilot who was stabbed has been identified in media reports as Indian Captain Smit Machchhar, a flydubai captain based in Dubai. His co-pilot was identified by Israeli officials as an Omani national who allegedly tried to take control of the aircraft. The Boeing 737 reportedly descended rapidly during the confrontation before passengers and crew intervened. The aircraft subsequently landed safely at Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where both pilots were taken to hospital. Flydubai has confirmed that an incident occurred on board but has not publicly confirmed the identities or nationalities of the pilots.Netanyahu also said another crew member subsequently entered the cockpit and helped stabilise the aircraft. “Another air crew that was on the plane entered the cockpit and managed to stabilize the plane,” he said. He praised those who intervened, saying: “I salute these heroes who showed exceptional resourcefulness and courage. They saved many lives and prevented a major disaster.”Get the latest India News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Upanishads to Mahabharata: NCERT explains roots of national, SC mottos
articles.summary: New Delhi: NCERT’s new Class IX social science textbook traces India’s national motto, “Satyameva Jayate”, to the Mundaka Upanishad and the Supreme
articles.body: New Delhi: NCERT’s new Class IX social science textbook traces India’s national motto, “Satyameva Jayate”, to the Mundaka Upanishad and the Supreme Court’s “Yato Dharmastato Jayah” to the Mahabharata, linking modern institutions to ancient texts. The lesson presents these connections as expressions of the values and responsibilities that should guide governance in a democracy.“Understanding Society: India and Beyond”, Part 2, became available on Tuesday, September 29, nearly six months into the academic session. Part 1 came out in June. The six-chapter volume, which TOI reported on Wednesday, spans history, geography, political science and economics under the National Education Policy 2020 and National Curriculum Framework for School Education 2023.The chapter “Governance and Public Policy” translates the national motto as “Truth alone triumphs” and the Supreme Court’s motto as “Where there is Dharma (righteous duty), there is victory”. It places these alongside the Sengol and Gandhi’s conception of Ram Rajya.These references are “not just symbolic or superficial”, the book says, but express institutional values and the responsibility to ensure good governance. It contrasts the national motto with “Heaven’s Light, Our Guide”, used by the British Order of the Star of India. The chapter acknowledges that colonial institutions persisted after Independence, but says India’s leaders framed the Constitution in keeping with India’s own values and ideals.The Sengol is described as a “cultural marker of rulership and good governance”, with a tradition dating back more than 1,000 years to the Cholas. Prime Minister Narendra Modi installed it near the Lok Sabha Speaker’s chair in the new Parliament building on May 28, 2023.The textbook recounts Jawaharlal Nehru receiving the sceptre from Tamil Nadu’s Adheenam saints at Independence. Modi had described it as a symbol of the transfer of power. Congress disputed this in 2023, saying there was no documentary evidence that Mountbatten, C Rajagopalachari or Nehru had described it in those terms.Gandhi’s Ram Rajya is presented as an ideal rooted in probity, transparency, compassion and welfare. The chapter links it to the Ramayana and 16th-century Ramcharitmanas, calling it “one of the best examples of good governance and a good collective life”. It discusses Rajdharma as the ruler’s duty to protect people and uphold righteousness.“Good governance was measured not only by the ruler’s authority but by the peace, prosperity, justice, and well-being in society,” it says. The chapter also draws on Kautilya’s Arthashastra to place the ruler’s happiness in the happiness of the people.The chapter also identifies seven features of good governance: responsiveness, transparency, participation, rule of law, accountability, effectiveness and inclusiveness.It stresses citizens’ rights, equality before the law and access to public services, while assigning responsibilities to government, citizens, the media, civil society and the private sector in achieving public welfare.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Palestinian-born US mosque leader faces deportation after judge rules he is ‘foreign policy threat’
articles.summary: A US immigration judge has ruled that Salah Sarsour, the Palestinian-born leader of Wisconsin’s largest mosque, can be deported on grounds that he poses a
articles.body: A US immigration judge has ruled that Salah Sarsour, the Palestinian-born leader of Wisconsin’s largest mosque, can be deported on grounds that he poses a foreign policy threat, while rejecting allegations that he lied on his green card application.According to The Associated Press, Sarsour, president of the Islamic Society of Milwaukee, was detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers in Milwaukee in March. A federal judge ordered his release in June, saying he had raised a “substantial” claim that the Trump administration may have targeted him for speaking out against Israel and advocating for Palestinian rights.Sarsour said the latest ruling was “deeply disappointing” and that he plans to appeal.“I will continue fighting to defend the right to free speech and to stay in the country I have called home for more than three decades,” he said.The US government has argued that Sarsour’s decades-old terrorism-related convictions in Israel make him a national security threat and alleged that he concealed them while applying for a green card.Immigration Judge Jayme Salinardi agreed that Sarsour could be deported on foreign-policy grounds but rejected the allegation that he lied on his application, AP reported.Sarsour fears deportation to West Bank could cost him his lifeSarsour was born in the Israeli-occupied West Bank and has lived in the US since 1993. He was imprisoned in Israel in 1988 after confessing to throwing a Molotov cocktail and stones at Israeli military personnel. In 1995, he was convicted of attempting to possess weapons and ammunition.Sarsour denies committing the offences. His lawyers have argued that he was tortured and coerced into confessing by Israeli authorities.Sarsour does not have a criminal record in the US. His lawyers also say US authorities have known about his convictions in Israel for decades and that he never concealed the information from immigration officials.“If I am sent back to the West Bank, it means the end of my life,” Sarsour told AP in an interview on Tuesday.His attorney Patrick Taurel said Sarsour’s previous treatment by Israeli authorities could indicate what he might face if deported.Lawyer says Sarsour will appeal deportation rulingTaurel said Sarsour was being unfairly targeted and would challenge the deportation order.“If Salah can be deported for his speech in support of Palestinian rights, anyone can face the same fate,” Taurel said, according to AP.The case comes after Secretary of State Marco Rubio issued a memo in June 2025 saying Sarsour could be deported on similar grounds used against Palestinian rights advocates Mahmoud Khalil and Mohsen Mahdawi, according to court documents cited by AP.Sarsour's legal team is expected to argue that he could face torture if returned to the West Bank. Taurel acknowledged that proving such a claim would be difficult but said Sarsour’s previous experience and Israel’s treatment of similarly situated Palestinians could support the case.Sarsour's lawyers have also questioned why US authorities detained him only this year despite allegedly knowing about his past in Israel for decades.Jawad Boulos, who represented Sarsour during his Israeli case, testified that he was coerced into confessing and was not convicted of an offence linking him to a terrorist organisation. Other witnesses, including Sarsour’s brother, also testified about his physical condition and alleged mistreatment while in Israeli custody.The Israeli government rejects allegations of abuse and wrongdoing in its treatment of Palestinian prisoners.A US federal judge had ordered Sarsour's release from ICE custody in June while his immigration case continued. The judge said Sarsour could have a valid claim that the government had retaliated against him for exercising his free speech rights and noted that ICE and the Department of Homeland Security had not adequately explained why he was suddenly considered a threat after decades of legal residency.The Trump administration has appealed that decision.Sarsour also lost more than 30 pounds while in ICE custody, according to his lawyers, who raised concerns about his medical treatment. An AP and KFF Health News investigation found that hundreds of immigration detainees across at least 33 states had filed federal lawsuits alleging medical neglect.Sarsour is among several people arrested in the US and threatened with deportation after publicly supporting Palestinians since the Israel-Hamas war began in October 2023.You use AI every day. articles.title: US troops finally leave Iraq: 23 years after Saddam’s fall, America closes a long chapter
articles.summary: Twenty-three years after American troops crossed into Iraq to overthrow Saddam Hussein, the last US forces have left the country.
articles.body: Twenty-three years after American troops crossed into Iraq to overthrow Saddam Hussein, the last US forces have left the country.It is not the first time Washington has withdrawn. US forces departed in 2011, only to return less than three years later when ISIS swept across large parts of Iraq and Syria. This time, the final troops left mainly from an airbase in Erbil in the semi-autonomous Kurdistan Region on September 30, formally concluding the latest chapter of America's military presence in Iraq.But the departure leaves Iraq with a question that is bigger than the presence of American troops: what happens when the security responsibility is entirely its own?For Baghdad, the withdrawal is a powerful statement of national sovereignty and puts greater responsibility on Iraq's security institutions. For the Kurdistan Region, however, it removes a crucial security partner at a time of intense regional conflict. And across Iraq, questions remain over ISIS sleeper cells, powerful armed groups and whether the state can establish effective control over the use of force.The withdrawal does not end the US-Iraq relationship. Washington has said it will continue targeted training and intelligence support, while the two countries are expected to retain cooperation in security, information exchange and economic relations. Iraq also remains deeply connected to the US-linked international dollar system.From the 2003 invasion to the final withdrawalThe current departure closes the latest chapter of a history that began with the US-led invasion of Iraq in March 2003, which overthrew Saddam Hussein's government. Washington had justified the invasion partly through claims that Iraq possessed weapons of mass destruction, but no stockpiles were subsequently found.The invasion was followed by insurgency, sectarian violence and years of instability. US forces formally withdrew in December 2011.The rise of ISIS changed the situation. In 2014, the group captured Mosul and large parts of Iraq and Syria. At Baghdad's request, the United States returned with an international coalition to support Iraqi forces, alongside Kurdish Peshmerga units and other partners.ISIS lost its territorial strongholds in Iraq by 2017. Although the coalition's combat mission formally ended in 2021, US personnel remained in support, training, intelligence and counterterrorism roles.The September 2024 agreement ultimately set the path for the latest US military withdrawal.Under the two-stage plan agreed by Washington and Baghdad, the coalition's military mission in Iraq was to conclude by the end of September 2025. Iraq would then continue to provide a platform for coalition support to counter-ISIS operations in Syria until September 2026.The final withdrawal from KurdistanMost US forces had already left bases in federal Iraq during earlier stages of the transition. A smaller contingent remained in the Kurdistan Region, making the final departure from Erbil particularly significant.The timing is also important. Iraq has been caught between competing US and Iranian interests during a period of wider regional confrontation. Kurdish territory and American positions in northern Iraq have faced drone and missile threats during the recent conflict.For Baghdad, the withdrawal means assuming greater responsibility for national security. For Erbil, it means losing a major military partner that provided intelligence, training and other security assistance.The United States, however, is not leaving Iraq's broader diplomatic and economic landscape. Washington and Baghdad are expected to retain bilateral cooperation in areas including counterterrorism, intelligence, training, information exchange and economic relations.Erbil without US troopsThe security implications are particularly significant for the Kurdistan Region.Kurdish authorities have maintained a close security relationship with Washington for more than a decade, especially during the fight against ISIS. The region has also faced substantial drone and ballistic-missile threats during the recent regional conflict.The Kurdistan Regional Government has raised concerns about the loss of US security capabilities following the American withdrawal. The issue is especially sensitive because the Kurdistan Region is an autonomous federal region rather than an independent state, and its relationship with Baghdad remains complicated by disputes over oil revenues, budgets, territory and the limits of Kurdish autonomy.The withdrawal could therefore increase the importance of security coordination between Erbil and Baghdad.ISIS has lost territory, not its networkThe territorial defeat of ISIS did not eliminate the organisation.The group now operates primarily through clandestine networks rather than the large territorial structure it controlled between 2014 and 2017. Iraqi forces continue to conduct operations against ISIS remnants.The end of the US military deployment raises questions about the future availability of American intelligence, surveillance and technical support, although the Pentagon has said Washington will continue providing targeted training and intelligence assistance to Iraqi partners.Iraqi security forces will now have greater responsibility for preventing ISIS from rebuilding its capabilities.The US withdrawal therefore does not mean the ISIS threat has disappeared. Instead, the burden of containing the remaining network increasingly falls on Iraqi institutions.The PMU question: Who controls the guns?Another major issue is the Popular Mobilisation Forces, or PMU/PMF.Created in 2014 to fight ISIS, the PMU is an umbrella organisation containing numerous armed formations and has since become part of Iraq's formal security architecture. Most of its factions are Shia, including powerful groups with close ties to Iran, but the organisation also contains Sunni and minority formations.The central issue is the degree of autonomy and political influence retained by some constituent groups.In his September 25 address to the UN General Assembly, Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi said Iraq was committed to ensuring that the state remained the ultimate authority over war and peace and that weapons and instruments of force remained under constitutional institutions.Al-Zaidi had earlier pledged to disarm powerful Iran-aligned militias by September 30, 2026, the same date set for the withdrawal of the remaining coalition forces. Several groups rejected that deadline.He has since indicated that the broader process of bringing armed groups under state control could run until June 30, 2027. Control over weapons therefore remains one of Baghdad's major post-withdrawal challenges.Iraq's oil revenue and Washington's financial leverageThe end of the US military presence does not eliminate Washington's financial influence over Iraq.Iraq remains heavily dependent on oil revenues, while its access to the international dollar system remains closely connected to US-based financial institutions. Iraqi oil revenues are held through an account belonging to Iraq's central bank at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, giving Washington significant leverage over Iraq's access to dollar transactions.The distinction is important: **the money belongs to Iraq, not the United States**.The arrangement developed after the 2003 invasion, when the US-led Coalition Provisional Authority created the Development Fund for Iraq. That eventually evolved into the current central-bank account at the New York Fed.The system provides Iraq with access to the international financial system while also giving Washington influence over the mechanisms through which Iraqi oil revenues are transferred and converted into dollars.This means military sovereignty and financial independence are not necessarily the same thing.What did Iraq's prime minister tell the UN?Speaking at the 81st UN General Assembly on September 25, Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi said Iraq wanted the state to have the final authority over decisions of war and peace and for weapons to remain under constitutional institutions.He also described the end of the international coalition mission as the beginning of a new phase in Iraq's relations with strategic partners, shifting the focus from military cooperation towards economic and development cooperation.Al-Zaidi highlighted the **Development Road**, which aims to connect the Grand Faw Port with Türkiye and European markets, and said Iraq wants to develop its energy potential and strengthen its position as a regional economic and energy hub.What does the withdrawal mean for Baghdad?For Baghdad, the withdrawal provides an opportunity to demonstrate that Iraq can manage its security without a permanent US military presence.But it also transfers greater responsibility to Iraqi forces. Baghdad must maintain counterterrorism capabilities, prevent an ISIS resurgence, protect critical infrastructure and manage competing armed groups.The militia issue is particularly important. If the Iraqi state cannot exercise effective authority over weapons, the departure of foreign troops alone will not resolve the country's broader sovereignty challenge.The focus of the sovereignty debate therefore shifts from **foreign forces inside Iraq to who controls the use of force inside Iraq**.What does it mean for the Kurds?For the Kurdistan Region, the calculation is more complicated.The US has been a major security partner for Kurdish forces, particularly since the fight against ISIS began. The loss of a permanent American military presence comes as Erbil faces continuing drone and missile threats.Kurdish political divisions also matter. The KDP and PUK maintain different relationships with Baghdad, Washington, Türkiye and Iran. The US departure could therefore increase pressure on Kurdish leaders to strengthen coordination with Baghdad while reassessing their wider regional security relationships.Sovereignty for Baghdad, a new security test for ErbilThe US withdrawal marks the end of a major chapter in America's military involvement in Iraq, but it does not end the broader relationship between the two countries.Baghdad now has greater responsibility for national security, ISIS containment and control over armed groups. Erbil, meanwhile, must adjust to the loss of a major security partner.At the same time, Iraq remains deeply connected to the US-linked global financial system and continues to depend heavily on oil exports.The significance of September 30 therefore extends beyond the departure of American troops. It marks a transfer of security responsibility to Iraqi institutions — and a new test of whether Baghdad can consolidate state authority while maintaining security across the country, including the Kurdistan Region.You use AI every day. articles.summary: A 1940s Glendale home with ties to Hollywood actor Ralph Bellamy has found a buyer just a week after hitting the market for $4.795 million.
articles.body: A 1940s Glendale home with ties to Hollywood actor Ralph Bellamy has found a buyer just a week after hitting the market for $4.795 million. The 1.25-acre property, located near Griffith Park, features a Tudor-style residence, equestrian facilities, a pool and extensive private grounds.The Riverside Rancho property was once owned by actor Ralph Bellamy, the Tony Award-winning performer known for films including His Girl Friday, The Wolf Man and The Awful Truth, for which he received an Academy Award nomination.It is not known exactly when Bellamy lived at the home.Located just a short distance from the Los Angeles Equestrian Center in Griffith Park, the property offers its own extensive equestrian setup, including stables, a barn, tack storage and a fenced riding arena.The listing was handled by Brit Schneeman and Emil Schneeman of Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices California Properties.Seller calls it an ‘urban ranch’The property’s seller, marketing executive Zihla Salinas Arbit, highlighted its combination of privacy, landscaping and proximity to Griffith Park.“There is nothing like it so close to the city,” Salinas Arbit said, according to Mansion Global.“It is an urban ranch like no other with gorgeous mature landscaping, complete privacy and our own direct trail access out to the 60 miles of ridable trails in Griffith Park.”Salinas Arbit and her husband, Oren Arbit, purchased the property in December 2021 for $4.15 million, according to PropertyShark records.Tudor-style home retains its historic characterSet behind gated brick walls, the Tudor-style residence is reached through a long driveway leading to a motor court.The two-story house spans nearly 4,000 square feet and retains several features that reflect its 1940s origins.The interiors include wood-paneled walls and ceilings, a country-style eat-in kitchen and three fireplaces. A dark blue-gray bar with a small stained-glass window adds to the home’s old-Hollywood atmosphere.The Arbits renovated the interiors during their ownership, while also updating the barn and equestrian facilities.“We did a lot of renovations to update the home for our family while preserving the natural charm of this California ranch-style home,” Salinas Arbit said.Property includes pool, guest space and equestrian facilitiesThe home has three bedrooms, including a primary suite painted dark green with a walk-in closet and an updated bathroom.Beyond the main residence, the property includes a four-car garage, swimming pool, hot tub and separate guest accommodations.Its equestrian amenities include stables, a barn, tack storage and a fenced riding arena, giving the property a distinctly ranch-style character despite its location within the Los Angeles area.Plans approved for home additionBefore putting the property on the market earlier this month, the seller obtained approved architectural plans and permits for a three-bedroom, two-bathroom addition.The property was listed for $4.795 million and went into contingent status just one week after being listed, according to the report.The combination of its Hollywood history, large grounds and equestrian facilities made the Glendale property a distinctive offering close to Griffith Park and central Los Angeles.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? articles.title: Flydubai flight drama: Rescue flight carrying passengers lands in Israel
articles.summary: A flydubai rescue flight carrying around 174 passengers landed at Israel’s Ben Gurion International Airport after their Tel Aviv-bound flight made an
articles.body: A flydubai rescue flight carrying around 174 passengers landed at Israel’s Ben Gurion International Airport after their Tel Aviv-bound flight made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia following an altercation between the pilots.After the landing, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu also met the passengers.Meanwhile, news agency Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia rejected an Israeli request to allow an Israeli aircraft to bring back the passengers stranded in Tabuk.According to sources cited by Reuters, Israel’s air force was preparing to send Super Hercules aircraft to Saudi Arabia to pick up the passengers. However, Riyadh turned down the request. Saudi Arabia does not have diplomatic relations with Israel.The incident occurred after a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Tabuk on Wednesday following an altercation between the pilots. The incident initially raised fears of a possible hijacking and prompted Israel to scramble fighter jets.The aircraft, carrying around 180 Israeli passengers, landed safely at Tabuk. An investigation into the incident is underway.An Israeli official told the Associated Press that a fight broke out between the pilots and that one of them was armed with a knife. Reuters reported that the co-pilot was believed to have stabbed the captain before cabin crew members entered the cockpit.Another regional official also confirmed that an altercation had taken place in the cockpit, although the cause of the fight was not immediately clear.The aircraft’s captain and first officer were injured and taken to hospital, according to a statement from Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Tabuk, carried by Saudi state-run Al Ekhbariya television.Netanyahu calls it 'serious security incident'Netanyahu said evidence indicated that the flydubai pilot had stabbed his fellow pilot and claimed that the pilot intended to crash the plane.Referring to the flight, which diverted to Saudi Arabia and landed in Tabuk, Netanyahu said an Israeli passenger he spoke to and a crew member managed to stop the pilot while he was attempting to damage the aircraft’s systems.In a video statement, Netanyahu described the incident as “an extremely serious security incident”, according to The Times of Israel.He said another crew member entered the cockpit and managed to stabilise the aircraft.Netanyahu added that Saudi authorities were interrogating the suspect and said he “salutes the heroes” who saved the passengers’ lives.He also met National Security Adviser Shmuel Ben Ezra and Military Secretary Maj Gen Guy Markizeno.You use AI every day. articles.title: Florida woman accused of firing at Rihanna, A$AP Rocky’s home indicted on attempted murder, 13 other felony counts
articles.summary: A Florida woman accused of driving across the country and opening fire at Rihanna and A$AP Rocky’s Beverly Hills-area home has been indicted by a grand
articles.body: A Florida woman accused of driving across the country and opening fire at Rihanna and A$AP Rocky’s Beverly Hills-area home has been indicted by a grand jury on 14 felony counts, including attempted murder.According to The Associated Press, the indictment against 36-year-old Ivanna Lisette Ortiz of Orlando was unsealed on Wednesday, a day after a judge ruled that she was mentally competent to stand trial. Ortiz appeared in court in yellow jail clothing, while her attorney entered a not guilty plea on her behalf. A judge ordered her held on USD 2.6 million bail.Bullets hit trailer, nursery where children wereOrtiz had previously been charged in March with attempting to murder Rihanna and with more than a dozen other felony offences. The new grand jury indictment replaces those charges and could allow prosecutors to bypass California’s preliminary hearing process.No one was injured in the shooting, but authorities said bullets struck an Airstream trailer occupied by Rihanna and A$AP Rocky. Gunfire also hit the exterior wall of a second-floor nursery where the couple’s three children were with their nanny.The indictment includes 10 counts of assault with an assault weapon and three counts of shooting at an inhabited dwelling or camper, in addition to the attempted murder charge. Ortiz could face life in prison if convicted on all counts.Police say Ortiz drove from Florida with rifleAuthorities allege that Ortiz drove a Tesla from Orlando to the Beverly Hills-area property on March 8 before pointing an AR-15-style rifle out of the vehicle and firing at least 20 rounds towards the property and a neighbouring house.Investigators found bullet holes in the trailer and on the exterior wall of the nursery. Rihanna’s mother and several members of the household staff were also inside the home at the time.Ortiz was arrested later the same day. Investigators said she told them, “I wasn’t attempting murder.”The case had been delayed for months while Ortiz underwent psychiatric evaluations. Records detailing those evaluations have been sealed, and authorities have not publicly disclosed information about her mental state.Prosecutors have also not stated a motive or identified any known connection between Ortiz and Rihanna. Ortiz, a longtime licensed speech pathologist, had no prior criminal record, according to the reports.Rihanna, a nine-time Grammy Award winner, has had 14 No. 1 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, including “We Found Love”, “Work”, “Umbrella” and “Disturbia”.You use AI every day. articles.title: Two Indian nationals found guilty in US cargo theft conspiracy; TVs, laptops, appliances worth $2m stolen
articles.summary: Two Indian men, Arshpreet Singh and Vikramjeet Singh, were found guilty in a US court for their involvement in a cargo theft conspiracy, stealing consumer goods valued at $2 million using fraudulent shipping contracts.
articles.body: Two Indian nationals have been found guilty in the US of conspiring to steal cargo by using legitimate trucking companies to secure shipping contracts and then taking the goods without delivering them to their intended destinations.According to the US Attorney’s Office for the Central District of California, Arshpreet Singh, 28, of Sacramento, and Vikramjeet Singh, 31, of Fontana, were found guilty after a seven-day jury trial. Arshpreet was also convicted of conspiracy to commit wire fraud, while both men were found guilty of conspiracy to commit theft from interstate or foreign shipments.Prosecutors said the conspiracy operated from March 2024 to June 2025. Singh and his co-conspirators allegedly acquired established trucking companies or fraudulently used them to obtain genuine shipping contracts. After collecting the cargo, they allegedly kept the goods instead of completing the deliveries.The stolen shipments included televisions, laptops, appliances and other high-value consumer goods. Vacuums, LED lights, shoes and tyres were also taken, with the losses estimated at at least $2 million.The thefts occurred across Southern California, including Fontana, Vernon, Santa Fe Springs, Perris, City of Industry, Long Beach, Compton, Commerce, Pico Rivera, Chino and Moreno Valley. A shipment was also stolen in Grand Prairie, Texas.In one case, Arshpreet Singh allegedly agreed to buy Texas-based carrier Z&F Transportation LLC for about $22,000 in March 2024. Later that month, a co-conspirator acting for the company collected a shipment of televisions in Fontana that was meant for delivery to Florida but never reached its destination.Another trucking company, Skyways Trucking LLC, was purchased by co-conspirators in May 2024, prosecutors said. Loads including laptops, televisions and solar panels were subsequently booked through freight brokers, including Uber Freight, before the cargo was allegedly taken instead of delivered.Vikramjeet Singh was acquitted of a separate charge of conspiracy to commit wire fraud.US District Judge Anne Hwang has scheduled sentencing for January 20 next year. Arshpreet Singh faces a statutory maximum of 20 years in federal prison, while Vikramjeet Singh faces a maximum of five years.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: IIT-B suicide: Student’s parents seek police security ; protesters claim ‘bid to evict’
articles.summary: IIT Bombay student suicide: Parents seek police protection citing safety concerns; protesting students allege eviction bid and demand professor’s suspension, probe changes.
articles.body: Mumbai: Ravindra Wakode, father of IIT-Bombay student Sahil (20), who died by suicide on Sept 18, has sought immediate police protection for himself and his wife, Sonali, citing concerns over their safety during the ongoing investigation. Wakode was on hunger strike for the fourth day. Meanwhile, some of the students who are still staging a peaceful protest at the IIT-Bombay main gate, 13 days after the incident, have alleged that they were being forcibly moved out of the site on Wednesday morning.The students claimed that the authorities have accused them of blocking the main gate, which they said they were not. They also sent out a list of demands to the institute’s administration. In response, they alleged, the administration ‘sent a security officer to intimidate students and threatened to move the barricades’. Apart from immediate suspension of Prof Suryanarayana Doolla from all responsibility, pending investigation, they have also sought to ensure that Sahil’s parents feel safe to visit the campus and meet with students. They have also sought reconstitution of the internal investigation committee as many of its members have publicly expressed support for the professor.In a letter to the Mumbai police commissioner, Wakode has expressed apprehension that individuals named in the case could potentially exert pressure or influence the investigation.Seeking preventive measures, under section 15 A of the Atrocities Act, the family has requested police protection at their residence and during necessary travel connected with the investigation and legal proceedings. Wakode has urged the authorities to act urgently so that he and his family can participate in the proceedings without fear, intimidation or pressure. articles.title: 10 accounts get 2.4cr in 2 days, cops suspect laundering racket
articles.summary: Kolkata Police probe mule accounts at Park Street bank branch after Rs 2.5 crore deposited in 10 accounts; NCRP flags trigger action, PAN crackdown planned.
articles.body: Kolkata: Lalbazar has launched a probe into a money-laundering racket, allegedly operating mule accounts from Park Street and is trading in crores.Cops said fraudsters allegedly gained unauthorized control of at least ten bank accounts being operated from a private bank branch located near Apeejay House on Park Street, siphoning off nearly Rs 2.5 crore within weeks, the last 48-hour window witnessing the largest transactions.Investigators revealed that the network duped citizens across India using an array of digital fraud tactics but parked the money in these 10 accounts. articles.title: Tourism ministry pours ₹94 crore into revival of historic Kharar lake
articles.summary: Tourism ministry approves ₹93.9 crore Swadesh Darshan project to rejuvenate historic Maharaja Ajj Sarovar in Kharar, boosting heritage tourism and conservation.
articles.body: Mohali: The Union ministry of tourism has approved a Rs 93.9-crore project under the Swadesh Darshan Scheme for the rejuvenation and redevelopment of the historic Maharaja Ajj Sarovar in Kharar.Spread across 133 kanals along the Kharar-Chandigarh National Highway, the site holds religious and cultural significance as it is traditionally associated with Maharaja Ajj, the grandfather of lord Rama.The comprehensive project aims to build modern tourism infrastructure, upgrade visitor facilities, and preserve the heritage site to position the water body as a major cultural destination in Punjab.The funding approval follows joint efforts by Punjab governor Gulab Chand Kataria, who advocated for the proposal after visiting the site earlier this year, and chief minister Bhagwant Mann, who directed state officials to submit the detailed project report (DPR).The approval marks the culmination of a four-decade campaign led by journalist and Shri Ram Mandir Ajj Sarovar Vikas Committee president Shashi Pal Jain, whose advocacy began following a media report on the site’s neglect in the mid-1980s. Community efforts have since led to the renovation of ghats and the construction of a temple dedicated to Rama and his ancestors through public donations.Historical records highlight the site’s archaeological importance, with British-era excavations revealing relics linked to Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain traditions, leading to protective colonial orders in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.Water restoration a key challengeWhile the project approval marks a major step towards redevelopment of the sarovar, stakeholders said restoring its water supply would be crucial to the long-term conservation of the site.Rapid urbanisation around Kharar has disrupted the natural watershed that traditionally fed the water body. Conservationists have therefore stressed the need to restore the site’s original hydrological and ecological systems along with the proposed tourism infrastructure.The Rs 93.9-crore project is expected to provide the sarovar with improved visitor amenities and conservation infrastructure while strengthening its position as a heritage and cultural tourism destination in Punjab.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Chandigarh | Silver Rate in Chandigarh | Bank Holidays in Chandigarh | Public Holidays in Chandigarh | Chandigarh AQI | Weather in Chandigarh | Petrol Price in Chandigarh | Diesel Price in Chandigarh | CNG Price in Chandigarh | LPG Price in ChandigarhStay updated with the latest Chandigarh news. articles.title: After coldest night, Indore sees hottest day of Sept in decade
articles.summary: Indore records decade-high September max of 35°C after coldest night; clear skies and no rain as monsoon withdrawal nears, with more heat expected.
articles.body: Indore: After recording its coldest Sept night in a decade, Indore on Wednesday registered its hottest Sept day in 10 years, as clear skies pushed the maximum temperature to 35 degrees Celsius, 2 degrees above normal. Tuesday’s maximum was 34.3 degrees Celsius, 1 degree above normal.The highest maximum temperature recorded in the city in the month was 37.4 degrees Celsius on Sept 27, 1987.On Tuesday, the city recorded its lowest night temperature for Sept in a decade after mercury dropped to 16.6 degrees Celsius.Despite rising daytime temperatures, the night remained relatively cool on Wednesday, with the minimum settling at 18.9 degrees Celsius, two degrees below normal. The city received no rain during the day. At 5.30 pm, the temperature was 30.8 degrees Celsius and relative humidity was 44%.Conditions are gradually becoming favourable for the southwest monsoon to withdraw from the remaining parts of Madhya Pradesh over the next two to three days, IMD Bhopal meteorologist Arun Sharma said.The withdrawal line currently passes through Gurdaspur, Chandigarh, Muzaffarnagar, Aligarh, Dholpur, Udaipur, Deesa and Naliya, among other locations. The monsoon is likely to withdraw from the remaining parts of Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh and most of Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh in the next two to three days, the weather department said. Further withdrawal is expected from all of Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand, and parts of Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra.The Met department has forecast a gradual two- to three-degree rise in maximum temperature over the next two days, followed by no significant change. With clear skies and the monsoon retreating, maximum temperatures in Indore may remain elevated in the coming days.
